name: DescriptionList
purpose: Read-only term-and-description facts with semantic description-list relationships.

guidance.useWhen: Use for labeled facts, attributes, metadata, or key/value details where terms describe one or more values, including compact-density metadata.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for tabular comparisons that require row and column relationships or for interactive form fields.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use semantic dl/dt/dd content across every framework surface. DescriptionList inherits VyrnForge density through shared tokens, so use compact density for dense key/value metadata instead of creating a separate KeyValueList API.

accessibility: Preserve native dl/dt/dd relationships; the renderer provides a native dl container and does not replace term/description semantics with generic grouping roles.
preserves native description-list semantics for term and description relationships
projected content must retain semantic term and description structure rather than generic grouping roles
knownLimitations: Avoid for tabular comparisons that require row and column relationships or for interactive form fields.
